project.title: Breakout
project.description: Classic-inspired Breakout: move the paddle with LEFT/RIGHT, launch with A, clear 60 bricks in six coloured rows.
project.author: PRG32 Kit

fields.TEXT: Breakout: break every brick with the ball. A or START launches it.
The wall: one list item per brick, 1 = still standing.
One colour per row, made with rgb(red, green, blue).
Mode 0 = ball on paddle, 1 = playing, 2 = game over, 3 = wall cleared.
The player moves the paddle with LEFT and RIGHT.
While the ball waits, it rides on the paddle; A or START launches it.
After a game over or a cleared wall, START plays again.
Playing: move the ball, then check bricks, paddle and lives.
Move the ball one step and bounce on the three walls.
Which brick is under the centre of the ball?
Paddle hit: the further from the centre, the steeper the bounce.
Missing the ball costs a life.
No bricks left: the wall is cleared.
Show the score in the PRG32 status band.
SCORE
Painter's algorithm: background, score line, bricks, paddle, ball, messages.
